name: Crypto 7-day momentum, weekend-only exposure
author: Nidhi Kumari et al.

indicators.weekend definition: UTC weekend; paper alternative Fri close-Mon open

entry_long: During weekend, take long if prior 7-day return > 0; remain flat weekdays
entry_short: During weekend, short if prior 7-day return < 0; remain flat weekdays
exit: Reassess daily; hold only weekend interval
claimed_performance: Authors report weekend momentum exceeds weekdays, notably altcoins; reported results are paper-specific.
implementation_notes: Paper tests a 14-day alternative; resolve weekend UTC boundary from full article before replay.
